{"subject":"Recap: Northwind Grocers technical validation and next steps","body":"Hi Maya and Carlos,

Thanks for the time this morning. Here is where we landed.

Validated today: streaming inventory (point of sale and order feeds merged into one model, refreshing every 5 minutes, reading from your change feed with no queries against the order database), the store rollup across 212 stores with projected days to reorder point, and regional manager access through a row level policy on the region key, including one level of parent and child regions.

Next steps:
- Hannah: business case numbers for Priscilla (cost per store and the overstock reduction we modeled together) by Friday, October 2nd.
- Devon: change feed setup doc for Carlos's ops runbook, today.
- Maya: 30 minutes with Priscilla on Tuesday, October 6th at 10. Hannah and Devon will join.

If Priscilla needs anything else ahead of that meeting, tell us and we will prepare it.

Best,
Hannah","customer_value_line":"The store rollup and the 5 minute merged inventory model are aimed at your goal of store managers seeing on hand including open orders within minutes, so you stop shipping to stores that are already full.","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U002","excerpt":"We want store managers to see on hand including open orders within minutes, so we stop shipping to stores that are already full."},{"utterance_id":"U003","excerpt":"It refreshes every 5 minutes, and there's no separate streaming product involved."},{"utterance_id":"U005","excerpt":"We read from the change feed you set up, so no queries against the order database itself."},{"utterance_id":"U007","excerpt":"212 stores, each with projected days to reorder point, computed in parallel per store."},{"utterance_id":"U011","excerpt":"One level of parent and child works out of the box. You described one level, so you're covered."},{"utterance_id":"U017","excerpt":"Yes, I'll send it by Friday the 2nd."},{"utterance_id":"U018","excerpt":"I'll set up 30 minutes with her for Tuesday, October 6th at 10."},{"utterance_id":"U019","excerpt":"I'll be there with Devon."},{"utterance_id":"U021","excerpt":"I'll send you the setup doc today."}]}
